properties.areaDesc: Southern Mono County; West Humboldt Basin - Pershing County; Lahontan Basin - Churchill and Eastern Mineral Counties
properties.headline: Red Flag Warning issued September 12 at 2:08AM PDT until September 13 at 2:00AM PDT by NWS Reno NV
properties.description:
* CHANGES...None.

* Affected Area...Fire Weather Zone 274 Southern Mono County,
Fire Weather Zone 423 West Humboldt Basin in Pershing County,
Fire Weather Zone 429 Lahontan Basin including Churchill and
Eastern Mineral Counties.

* Winds...Southwest 15 to 25 mph with gusts of 40 to 50 mph.

* Humidity...RH reductions to 10 to 15 percent in the afternoon.
Nighttime recoveries of 40 to 60 percent Sunday morning, except
30 to 40 percent in southern Mono and Mineral counties.

* Duration...3 to 6 hours.

* Impacts...The combination of strong winds and low humidity can
cause fire to rapidly grow in size and intensity before first
responders can contain them.
properties.instruction:
Avoid outdoor activities that can cause a spark near dry
vegetation, such as yard work, target shooting, or campfires.
Follow local fire restrictions. Check weather.gov/reno for
updates and livingwithfire.info for preparedness tips.

properties.areaDesc: Goose Creek and Raft River Valley/Southern Sawtooth NF/Twin Falls BLM south of the Snake River
properties.headline: Red Flag Warning issued September 12 at 3:07AM MDT until September 12 at 9:00PM MDT by NWS Pocatello ID
properties.description:
* AFFECTED AREA...Fire Weather Zone 427 Goose Creek and Raft
River Valley/Southern Sawtooth NF/Twin Falls BLM south of the
Snake River.

* WINDS...West 10 to 20 mph with gusts up to 30 mph.

* RELATIVE HUMIDITY...As low as 13 percent.

* IMPACTS...Low humidity and moderate to strong wind causes
rapid fire spread and higher intensity wildfires.
properties.instruction:
A Red Flag Warning means that critical fire weather conditions
are either occurring now, or will shortly based on these criteria
for Southeastern Idaho:

- Relative humidity at or below 15 percent and wind gusts of at
least 25 mph in the mountains, or 30 mph in the Snake Plain.

- Thunderstorm coverage of 25 percent, without specific rainfall
criteria.

- Other high impact events deemed critical by the National
Weather Service and area fire management agencies.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 11 at 9:33PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Florida...

Horse Creek Near Arcadia at SR 72 affecting DeSoto County.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Horse Creek near Arcadia at SR 72.

* WHEN...From late Sunday night until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 12.0 feet, The access road to Hidden Oak is
impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:30 PM EDT Friday the stage was 7.8 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 12.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage early
Monday morning and continue rising to 12.3 feet Monday evening.
Additional rises are possible thereafter.
- Flood stage is 12.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 12.3
feet on 08/09/1957.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued Saturday afternoon at 100 PM EDT.

properties.headline: Red Flag Warning issued September 11 at 12:47PM MDT until September 12 at 9:00PM MDT by NWS Boise ID
properties.description:
...HOT AND DRY WITH GUSTY WINDS AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT SATURDAY
AFTERNOON AND EVENING...

Hot and dry conditions on Saturday will combined with increase
southerly winds ahead of an approaching cold front. Expect
sustained winds of 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 45 mph with
humidities between 15 and 20 percent. Eastern portions of 423
along with zone 426 has seen little to no rainfall in the last two
weeks keeping fuel critically dry.

The National Weather Service in Boise has issued a Red Flag
Warning for winds and low relative humidities, which is in effect
from noon to 9 PM MDT Saturday. The Fire Weather Watch is no
longer in effect.

* AFFECTED AREA...In Idaho, Fire Weather Zones 423 Owyhee
Mountains and 426 Southern Highlands.

* TIMING...From noon to 9 PM MDT Saturday.

* WINDS...Southwest 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 45 mph.

* RELATIVE HUMIDITY...15 to 20 percent.

* TEMPERATURES...78 to 88 degrees.

* IMPACTS...Any fire that develops will catch and spread
quickly. Outdoor burning is not recommended.
properties.instruction:
A Red Flag Warning means that critical fire weather conditions
are either occurring now, or will occur shortly.
